title: ONNX-EdgeIDS: A Lightweight Two-Stage Edge Serving Toolkit for Network Intrusion Detection
description:
ONNX-EdgeIDS is research software for deploying machine-learning network intrusion detection on resource-constrained edge devices. It provides Kafka and ZeroMQ replay for CICIDS2017-derived flow records, a first-stage anomaly gate that filters high-volume traffic, and a second-stage tree-ensemble classifier served by ONNX Runtime or by a dependency-minimal NumPy engine exported from the same ONNX graph, together with a release gate that checks the two runtimes agree before deployment.

This release adds research results; the serving toolkit (ONNX Runtime backend, NumPy engine, exporter, release gate and artifacts) is unchanged since 0.7.0. The research/ directory gains the cost of the gate's probe check for the crossing pair and the three-probe set, ranked fault localization over exporter and single-node faults, a gradual distribution shift mixing CICIDS2017 and CSE-CIC-IDS2018, Treelite compiled to C as a further runtime, repeated and stratified replay draws with a confidence-tolerance sweep, node, branch and crossing coverage of six input generators, and the data-free gate run with the default crossing pair on thirteen models for runtime and converter parity.
